thread:
maris (docs): Quick sync: an auditor asked for clearer guidance on 'chain of custody' for exported audit evidence. Our current pages show export steps but not how to record verification + archival metadata. We should add a recommended 'archive manifest' pattern.

dan (security): Good idea. Proposal: include a small manifest that accompanies exported bundles: export_id, tenant_id, exported_at, sha256, signed_by_platform, and verifier_steps. Keep it generic so customers can ingest into their evidence storage.

sofia (legal): From a compliance angle, prefer: 'Customers are responsible for retaining export artifacts and associated receipts to demonstrate evidence collection for SOC 2.' Use 'one year' or '365 days' uniformly when referring to the retention window.

maris (docs): OK I'll avoid promising retention changes. Draft manifest example to add in docs:```text
{
  "export_id": "exp_2026_03_01",
  "tenant_id": "t_xyz",
  "exported_at": "2026-03-01T12:00:00Z",
  "sha256": "<sha256>",
  "signed_receipt": "<hmac>",
  "notes": "verified and archived to customer-kms"
}
```

dan (security): Add verification checklist: 1) confirm sha256 matches, 2) run `redwood verify-receipt --receipt manifest.json --public-key platform.pub`, 3) log verification result into customer audit system. Also note we rotate platform keys; encourage customers to store verification logs.

lee (sdk): We'll need to update SDK examples and responses. v2 export returns `export_id`, `sha256`, and `signed_receipt`. Python example:```py
resp = client.export_logs(tenant_id="t_a1", export_window_days=365, format="jsonl")
print(resp["export_id"], resp["sha256"])  # then store manifest
```

lee (sdk): Migration note: old param `days` -> `export_window_days`; old responses without `signed_receipt` should be handled by checking presence and warning users. We'll add a small try/except snippet for graceful fallback.

sofia (legal): Add exact SOC 2 guidance sentence I can sign off on: 'To support SOC 2 evidence requests, customers should export and retain required audit artifacts within the 365-day retention window and preserve verification receipts.'

maris (docs): Will include Sofia's sentence in the compliance block. Also adding a short 'how to archive' example for S3 with server-side encryption and KMS: `aws s3 cp export.tar.gz s3://my-audit-bucket/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/my-key`.

dan (security): Good. Also include a note that exports are delivered over TLS and accompanied by a SHA256 checksum. Recommend verifying checksum before upload to customer storage.

maris (docs): I'll prepare a PR with: archive manifest example, SDK/CLI code snippets, migration note, S3/KMS archive command, and the SOC 2 sentence. Will add a tiny console screenshot showing the export artifact and manifest link.

ci-bot: docs build #9201 started by @maris.

lee (sdk): I'll open a companion SDK test that exercises the new response fields and link it in the PR comments.
